name: UniX AI
summary: UniX AI is a humanoid robotics company headquartered in Suzhou, China. It develops wheeled dual-arm and bipedal robots for home and commercial service applications, combining robot hardware with perception and manipulation software. Its product lineup includes Wanda, Panther and Martian. The company states that it was established in 2024.
